refactor(relational-core): rename freeze helpers to clarify copy semantics

freezeArray -> frozenArrayCopy, freezeOptionalObject ->
frozenOptionalRecordCopy, freezeRecord -> frozenRecordCopy.

Addresses SevInf review: names now communicate that these functions
shallow-copy before freezing, and use consistent 'record' terminology
instead of mixing 'object' and 'record'.
